subject: a compact jellyfish with a ceramic bell and neon ribs
pose: bell tilted, short tentacles curling into a base ring
requested_medium: ceramic and luminous tube creature sculpture
art_direction: 深海水母冠由青色光管与黑陶壳交织，触须短卷、橙色眼点平静，像夜间工艺角色。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Build a compact jellyfish from a charcoal ceramic bell threaded with thin cyan light tubes. The tubes follow six clear ribs and end above short tentacles that curl into a loose supporting ring. Two tiny amber eye points beneath the rim give the creature a serene observant presence. Keep the glow localized to the tubes so the ceramic texture remains visible. Use a deep blue-violet background with a faint warm reflection below the tentacles. The bell tilts slightly, revealing its hollow underside without becoming eerie. Center the entire sculpture inside the safe circular area of a square avatar, avoiding long trailing strands, bubbles, text, or a full underwater scene.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
